etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Old French divers, from Latin diversus (“various, different”), also written divorsus, past participle of diverto, divortere (“to turn or go different ways, part, separate, divert”); see divert.

definitions.definition: Consisting of many different elements; various.
Different; dissimilar; distinct; not the same

quote.citation: 1797?, Jonathan Edwards, A Dissertation Concerning Liberty and Necessity; containing remarks on the essays of Dr. Samuel West, and on the writings of several other authors, on those subjects.
quote.text: It must be observed concerning moral Inability, in each kind of it, that the word Inability is used in a sense very diverse from its original import.
Our roads are diverse: farewell, love! said she.

quote.citation: 1998, Ken Shelton, Integrity at Work, page 42:
quote.text: This is what collectivism forgot — the freedom to be diverse, and the conception of each diverse individual being inherently of equal value and having open-ended potential for contribution.

quote.citation: 2013 May-June, Katrina G. Claw, “Rapid Evolution in Eggs and Sperm”, in American Scientist, volume 101, number 3:
quote.text: In plants, the ability to recognize self from nonself plays an important role in fertilization, because self-fertilization will result in less diverse offspring than fertilization with pollen from another individual.
Eloquence is a great and diverse thing.

definitions.definition: Composed of people with a variety of different demographic characteristics in terms of, for example, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, etc., and having a sizeable representation of people that are minorities in a given area.

quote.citation: 2019 June 27, Lauren Gambino, “Democratic 2020 candidates clash on healthcare, immigration and economy in first debate”, in The Guardian‎[1]:
quote.text: The stage reflected the increasingly diverse Democratic party in which women and people of color are ascendent.

quote.citation: 2016 January 22, Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences[2]:
quote.text: The Board’s goal is to commit to doubling the number of women and diverse members of the Academy by 2020.

quote.citation: 2018 November 17, Saturday Night Live, season 44, episode 6, Voter Fraud (cold open):
quote.text: Here to comment is diverse Congresswoman from Ohio […]  Marcia Fudge.

quote.citation: 2021 August 23, “Mike Richards out as executive producer of 'Jeopardy!' and 'Wheel of Fortune'”, in NBC News:
quote.text: Richards came under fierce criticism since he was formally hired to emcee the legendary quiz show, with some longtime fans saying they believed the producers should have selected a more diverse candidate for the job, such as the actor and presenter LeVar Burton.
